definition time caution: Current portal metadata do not by themselves prove verbatim equivalence of all historic questionnaires.

common medication definition.setting: Primary health care facilities in the public health sector
common medication definition.No interpretation: Does not meet general availability threshold; not zero availability
common medication definition.measurement: Official country response, not a direct census of individual facilities or patient access
common medication definition.age: No adult-specific age restriction in downloaded capacity records

common technology definition.setting: Primary health care, private or public sector or both

items.label: 支气管扩张剂
items.api name: General availability of bronchodilators in the public health sector
items.portal label: General availability of bronchodilator inhalers in the public health sector
items.caution: Generic bronchodilator field. Salbutamol/SABA-only molecule identity not proven for all waves; preserve source label.

items.label: 吸入激素
items.api name: General availability of steroid inhalers in the public health sector
items.caution: Inhaled, not oral steroid. Separate ComboInhaler item is available in 2021. Do not equate No with absence of every anti-inflammatory inhaler. Single-component restriction needs questionnaire-level verification.

items.label: 复方吸入剂
items.api name: General availability of combination budesonide formoterol inhaler in the public health sector
items.caution: Specifies budesonide-formoterol. Availability is not correct prescription, reliever authorization, dose, device technique, or use of a GINA pathway.

items.label: 肺量计
items.api name: General availability of spirometry at the primary health care level
items.caution: Presence of technology is not verified diagnostic quality or correct asthma diagnosis.

items.label: 峰流速
items.api name: General availability of peak flow measurement at the primary health care level
items.caution: Current portal heading includes an apparent extra word spirometry, but the definition and API field are specifically peak flow. Do not combine the two measures.

items.label: 呼吸病计划
items.api name: Existence of operational policy/strategy/action plan for chronic respiratory diseases
items.definition summary: CRD-specific operational policy/strategy/action plan, or CRD included in an integrated NCD policy/strategy/action plan
items.caution: Policy indicator, not availability of actual diagnosis or treatment to patients.

items.label: 呼吸病指南
items.api name: Existence of evidence-based national guidelines/protocols/standards for the management of chronic respiratory diseases
items.definition summary: Government/competent authority approved or recognized national evidence-based guidelines/protocols/standards for CRD management through primary care
items.caution: Existence of guidance, not implementation, guideline concordance, or provision of care.

row schema.TimeDim: Survey year as reported by API; do not automatically treat as an annual facility audit
row schema.SpatialDim: WHO country code, mapped with DIMENSION/COUNTRY/DimensionValues
row schema.ParentLocationCode and ParentLocation: Original WHO region code and label; retained per record
row schema.Yes No Missing: Derived: only exact Yes/No are valid, all other values are Missing
row schema.Missing reason: Original non-Yes/No string, such as Don't know or No response, retained
row schema.Id and Date: Original API ID and Date retained, not survey year replacements

2023 status: 2023 survey reports and portal display exist. Global row-level 2023 data not obtained in this audit; these seven downloaded API series end in 2021.
